title: code-of-ethics
description: Tab-reveal composition for ethics, policy, or principles content. Tabs animate in sequence with a sliding coloured highlight. Suitable for any multi-topic slide with 3–8 sections.

title.description: Module title shown at top of composition

kicker.description: Uppercase kicker line above the title

unitCode.description: Unit code displayed as a chip in the top-right corner

basePlateImage.description: Filename of the ACS v2 base plate background PNG. Must be one of the six standard plate files.

tabs.description: JSON-encoded array of tab objects. Each object: { label (string), heading (string), body (string) }. Supports 2–8 tabs.
tabs.default: [{"label":"Conflict of Interest","heading":"Conflict of Interest","body":"Employees must avoid situations where personal interests conflict, or appear to conflict, with the interests of the organisation."}]

activeTab.description: Zero-based index of the tab shown at the start of the composition

tabColor.description: Active tab highlight colour, heading colour, and card left-border accent. Use an ACS plate colour.

tabBgColor.description: Background colour of the tab bar

cardColor.description: Background colour of the content card

textColor.description: Body text colour inside the content card

bgColor.description: Page background colour. Use ACS canvas #f5f2ea.

durationPerTab.description: Seconds each tab is displayed. Total composition duration = tabs.length × durationPerTab.
